title: Minarai Artifact
description: A single, generic Artifact format used for human/AI review (design docs, specs, test cases, etc.). Section-level uniqueness of `id` is enforced by the validator, not by this schema.

id.description: Stable identifier for the Artifact. Used to name its Review YAML file, so it must not contain path separators or '..'.

type.description: Free-form Artifact kind (e.g. design, test, standard). Not used to select a different renderer.

id.description: Stable Section identifier. Review comments reference this id, never a line number or DOM position.
